export_created.title: ThermoSmart – Research export created
export_created.message:
The ThermoSmart research export has been created.

The file contains detailed anonymized technical learning, sensor, decision, and outcome data. It is intended for analyzing and improving ThermoSmart.

The file does not contain room or zone names, entity IDs, device IDs, addresses, or exact location data. Please review the file before sharing it.

The file was created locally only; nothing was uploaded or transmitted. It will be deleted automatically after {retention_hours} hours – this also applies after a Home Assistant restart.

**Download (requires Home Assistant login):**
[{filename}]({download_url})
